TEMPTATION ||| Press the Answer deeper into my palm ||| “Let’s see if I can surprise you.”  
BOUNDARY ||| Pull my hand back, holding the Answer away ||| “I won’t answer until I know what’s at stake.”  
CONFESSION ||| Look him in the eyes, exposing my truth ||| “I care about what you think of me, Julian.”  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the Answer firmly, asserting control ||| “I will decide how this unfolds from here.”  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, holding my breath ||| *A soft exhale escapes, betraying my tension.*
